What it allows and how to remove it

It is the Android permission to change secure settings. With it, the rescue can turn TalkBack on, off or restart it, turn screen readers off in safe mode and back on, choose the speech engine and restore your settings, without going through Settings. Android does not let an app give it to itself: it is granted once from Android debugging or with root, and it stays after restarting and after updating the app.
To remove it, uninstall the app or type on a computer: %1$s
Step %1$d. %2$s
Method 1: from the phone itself, with wireless debugging
It needs Android 11 or later. On this phone, use the computer method or the root method.
No computer needed, but you need a Wi-Fi network. It is best done while your screen reader works.
Turn on developer options: in About phone, tap Build number seven times in a row (on some phones it is inside Software information). Android may ask for your PIN.

In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging. When Android asks whether to allow debugging on this network, tick «Always allow on this network» and accept: this way the app can use the system shell by itself later. Then open Wireless debugging.
Tap Pair device with pairing code. A window appears with a six-digit code.

Important: that window closes if you switch to another app, and then the code stops working. So it is best to type the code in the Accessible Rescue notification without leaving Settings, or to use split screen.
Recommended: type the code in a notification

Tap the button below before step 3. Then, with the code window open, pull down the notifications, find Accessible Rescue, choose Type the code, type the six digits and send. The app pairs and grants the permission by itself, and the notification tells you the result.

After granting it

You can now turn off wireless debugging and developer options: the permission stays. If the Wi-Fi network was left as allowed, when needed the app will turn them on for a moment by itself to fix things only the system shell can do (mono audio, balance, enabling apps, removing updates) and turn them off again.
